fixtures.notes: TURN-53 FABRICATION REPRO (George live session): the player OBSERVES a ditch slime while Maren is present. Maren's authored knowledge_scope lead (Severwick / deep dragon-lore) rides in as a held claim scoped 'lead'. The assembler MUST suppress it (source_lead_not_ambient) so the narrator never sees it and cannot have Maren volunteer an unsolicited dragon monologue. An observation of X yields a description of X, not a conversation. The one_hop meta is the promotion that surfaced the lead under the old assembler; the fix drops it regardless of meta.

fixtures.notes: PRODUCTION-CATEGORY variant of nf-21 (audit #2 npc/person mismatch). Identical turn-53 repro, but the present NPC Maren carries the PRODUCTION entity category "npc" (engine world.ENTITY_KINDS: npc|creature|item|prop; the PC folds to "character") instead of the legacy fixture label "person". Before the fix the narration gate detected persons only by category=="person", so G6/C9 (unsupported NPC speech) was INERT in production. This fixture drives the harness with the real contract so the pipeline is exercised against npc, not just person. Expected: the assembler still suppresses the lead, the narrator describes the slime, no unsolicited Maren monologue; if one were produced, G6/C9 now catch it under the npc category.
